tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Foundation rules: concrete values for motion, states, typography, spacing, surfaces, focus and anti-patterns. Pass a topic for one file; omit it for the token roles, the finished? checklist and the list of topics.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Every UI Polish template, block and component with a one-line summary and version. Templates are whole working apps (a chat app, an agent console, an agent workspace for coding); blocks are whole screens (sign-in, billing, team members, an approvals inbox, an agent task). Those marked pro need a UI

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: The code and guide for one component, block or template: when and when not to use it, every state, motion specs, accessibility notes, before/after. Includes the components it depends on and the npm packages to install. A template's own files come with the project path to write each one at (app/(app)

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: A color theme from one hue: the --ui-* accent, the text on it and in it, optionally tinted grays and accent primary buttons, light and dark, with every text color solved for 4.5:1 contrast. Returns CSS to paste after tokens.css. Use it when the project has a brand color.
